title: fix(plugin-view): route 2 reads a named view's fieldOrder, navigation and inlineEdit (objectui#10885, member 4)
body:
Fixes #10885
Clause-②: no

Member 4 of objectui#10885, under PM claim `5868584175` and the seat ruling in `5867513786` (option A widened by `data`, contract review `5866387245` item 10). Branch `claude/issue-10885-route2-named-view-rest`, head `bd41f5cf18`, base `06a96e9480`. The gates below ran at `600cf89017`; fix round 1 changes prose and one test docblock only.

Three of the five members land here: `navigation`, `inlineEdit` and `fieldOrder`. `label` and `data` are ruled B, not relayed on route 2 (seat ruling `5869413175`). `data`'s provider conflict is objectui#10971. Member 1 (PR objectui#10937) and member 3 (PR objectui#10955) have merged, and member 2 was enumerated, not graded (see Acceptance notes). So this PR closes the card.

**Fix round 1** (`bd41f5cf18`, prose only) applies contract review `5869604558`'s five wording fixes:
- `label` / `data` are stated with their reasons in both changesets, the README and the docs page;
- "named view", not "saved view", in Opening a record;
- the reach of a named `navigation` over the create and edit forms, including the New button under `split` / `popover` (objectui#10975);
- the host `onRowClick` qualifier;
- the member-1 pin docblock.

The review's two follow-up carriers are objectui#10975 and objectui#10976.

## What changed

All code is in `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`, outside both fences.

| member | the read | precedence | pins |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `navigation` | `navigationConfig` = `currentNamedViewConfig?.navigation ?? schema.navigation` | named view first, whole object, then the node. No per-key merge and no `activeView` rung. Its consumers follow it: `handleRowClick` (the `onRowClick` route 2 hands `ObjectGrid` and the delegation hands `renderListView`), `formLayout` and the drawer width | `ObjectView.namedViewNavigation-10885.test.tsx`: route 2 row click, whole-object, delegation row click, drawer width over `formLayout`, plus 3 controls |
| `inlineEdit` | `gridSchema.editable` = `currentNamedViewConfig?.inlineEdit` | named view only. Route 2's `gridSchema` literal carried no `editable` key at base (0 occurrences in that memo), so there is no node rung. `ObjectGrid` still ANDs it with the object's inline-edit verdict and the `update` grant (`inlineEditable`) | `ObjectView.namedViewInlineEdit-10885.test.tsx` (real `ObjectGrid`): an editor opens where the object grants inline edit; no editor where `userActions.edit` is false; control |
| `fieldOrder` | new module-private `inFieldOrder`, applied to both projection slots after `withoutHiddenFields` | named view only, like the fence's `fieldOrder` rung. It copies `ListView`'s `effectiveFields` step: a stable sort by position in `fieldOrder`, with unnamed or identity-less entries sorted last. A name the projection does not carry orders nothing, and with no projection nothing is added | `@object-ui/app-shell` `objectViewRouteParity.fieldOrder-10885.test.tsx`: both routes of the same `ObjectView` on the same named view, route 2's projection compared with what the real `ListView` hands its grid. 4 cases plus 2 controls |

Route 2's comment that said `navigation` "is not relayed" now says that it is still not relayed to `ObjectGrid`, and that the handler route 2 passes reads it.

Two files outside the claim's surface:
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts`: its `READ_TEXT.navigation` pins the exact text of the `navigationConfig` line, so it went red at head (1 of 237). The entry now spells the new line, which still reads `schema.navigation` as the fallback. No census figure moved (see below).
- `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/objectViewRouteParity.fieldOrder-10885.test.tsx`: the `fieldOrder` parity pin needs `ListView`. `@object-ui/plugin-view` does not depend on `@object-ui/plugin-list`, and `@object-ui/app-shell` is the one package that depends on both.

Prose:
- `packages/plugin-view/README.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx`: the member-1 sentence "`label`, `data` and `navigation`, also declared on both, are not read off the named view on this path" is replaced. The new text says what route 2 reads now (`fieldOrder`, `inlineEdit`, `navigation`) and what it still does not (`label`, `data`). The "Opening a record" section says an active saved view's `navigation` replaces the node's. A grep for the old sentence across the repository hit only these two files and the changeset below.
- `.changeset/10885-object-view-route2-named-grid.md` (pending): one dated note is appended in the objectui#10533 form. There are 2 insertions and 0 deletions, and the frontmatter md5 is `4d3ab4fd127d2f0feaabd7840d888656` before and after.
- `.changeset/10885-object-view-route2-named-view-rest.md` (new): `'@object-ui/plugin-view': patch`.

## Census

`object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779` and `schema-reference-named-list-view-keys-7923`:
- **Base** (`ObjectView.tsx` = base blob `34f0656469`): 237 passed of 237.
- **Head** `600cf89017`: all passed, in a 5-file run of 315 tests with the other three `packages/types` readers.

The partition is 43 read and 21 unread of 64 on both sides. The pins asserting it are "the renderer reads exactly forty-three names off a named view" and "the census partitions the declaration exactly: 43 read + 21 unread = 64". All three keys are already in the read set. `readSites.label` stays at 2, because no `label` read was added.

## Red on base, green on head, and per-member ablation

Each leg below started from HEAD. It proved its mutation was on disk with an occurrence count, ran the 3 new pin files (16 tests), then restored with `git checkout HEAD` and a blob-hash check (`git diff HEAD` empty).

| leg | mutation, proven on disk | result | red rows |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| base | `ObjectView.tsx` replaced by the base blob (hash equal, `inFieldOrder` 0 hits) | 7 passed, 9 failed | every non-control row of all three members |
| head | none | 16 passed | none |
| navigation | `navigationConfig` back to `schema.navigation` (named read 0, node-only 1) | 12 passed, 4 failed | exactly the 4 navigation fix rows |
| inlineEdit | the `editable` line removed (0 hits) | 15 passed, 1 failed | exactly the `inlineEdit` fix row |
| fieldOrder | `fieldOrder` forced `undefined` (read 0, ablated 1) | 12 passed, 4 failed | exactly the 4 parity rows |
| grant (can-fail proof) | `ObjectGrid`'s `inlineEditable` without `objectInlineEditable` | 2 passed, 1 failed | exactly "THE GRANT STILL WINS" |

The 7 base-green rows are the controls. Each base failure is an assertion failure, for example `expected [ 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd' ] to deeply equal [ 'c', 'a', 'b', 'd' ]`, or `onNavigate` not called with `r1`, `view`.

## `label` and `data`: measured, then ruled B

**`label`.** The order says: stop if relaying paints a second visible title. Measured by relaying it in a scratch copy with the real `ObjectGrid`:
- With two named views, the tab strip shows `LABEL_ALL` and the table gains a `caption` element reading `LABEL_ALL`.
- With one named view (no tab strip), the caption is the only label on screen.
- The delegation paints no caption either way, because `ListView` hands its grid no `label`.
- Relaying would also move the 7779 `readSites.label` pin from 2 to 3.

`label` is already read on route 2, as the tab strip's text.

**`data`.** The order says: stop if `ListView` and `ObjectGrid` disagree on a provider. Measured per provider on the same named view, with node `objectName` = `probe_task`:

| provider | delegation (`ListView`) | route 2 if relayed (`ObjectGrid`) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `value` | rows from `items` | rows from `items` |
| `object` (`other_obj`) | fetches `probe_task`, the node (objectui#7477 ruling B: an `objectName` already present wins) | fetches `other_obj` (record-source ladder: `data` first) |
| `api` | fetches `probe_task` | fetches `probe_task` |
| `schema` | fetches `probe_task` | fetches `probe_task` |

At head, route 2 fetches `probe_task` for all four.

## Acceptance notes

- **Member 2** (the delegation's eight view-kind blocks) was enumerated, not graded, and is not taken here, per triage execution note 2. Its reach, re-measured: `git grep -n "renderListView="` over non-test sources finds 3 host sites, two in the console object page and one in the Studio design surface. None of the schemas they pass carries `listViews`: the console page's `objectViewSchema` literal has 0 `listViews` hits, and `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` has 0. No in-tree host passes both.
- The `navigation` fix reaches the delegation by construction, through the shared handler. Since no in-tree host passes `listViews` there, its in-tree reach today is route 2: the Studio `ViewPreview` and authored nodes.
- The member-1 divergence the contract review noted still stands, unchanged: with a non-empty `hiddenFields`, route 2 keeps a column entry that has no identity and `ListView` drops it. The `fieldOrder` parity pins use identified columns.
- Relays that were measured and then reverted were scratch-only: the `label` and `data` relays, and a probe file that imported `@object-ui/plugin-list` from plugin-view. Nothing of them is in the branch.
